**Ollie OS 2.0**: the newest, cleanest Ollie OS. The fun gaming computer, made by biobro.

**Pick your installer** (it puts Ollie OS on a USB drive, 8 GB or more):
- **Ollie-OS-Installer-Windows.exe**: for Windows.
- **Ollie-OS-Installer-Mac.dmg**: for a Mac (Apple chip M1 to M4, or Intel). Needs Docker Desktop (free, docker.com).
- **Ollie-OS-Installer-x86_64.AppImage**: for Linux, SteamOS and the Steam Deck (desktop mode).

**Already have Ollie OS?** Open **Ollie-OS-Latest-Updater-x86_64.AppImage** on it to bring it up to 2.0.

**How the installers work** (all three the same): they look in your Downloads folder for Ollie OS first; if it is there, they use it. Otherwise they download the official Arch Linux and build a brand-new Ollie OS on your computer (1 to 2 hours, about 20 GB free; on a Mac with an Apple chip several hours), then put it on the USB drive.

**New in 2.0**
- The Mac installer builds Ollie OS the same way as the Windows and Linux ones, then writes the USB drive itself.
- All the installers look in Downloads first.
- Ollie OS says 2.0 in its Welcome window.

**Starting from the drive:** Steam Deck and Steam Machine, hold Volume Down; Dell and most PCs, tap F12; Intel Mac, hold Option. Then press Install Ollie OS.

Website: https://robertpjenkins-bot.github.io/Ollie-OS/
